thesis: Angelology is the structural backbone connecting all four texts + 900 Conclusions, unifying Pico's system.

nodes.role: Dignity thesis: human freedom vs. angelic fixed nature; ascent through hierarchy
Participatory intellection: seraphim as goal via love; Kabbalistic mysticism (binsica)
Cosmological framework: seven-layer angelology; Sefirotic + planetary angels
Metaphysical grounding: participated being; angels as degrees of being and unity
Celestial magic: angelic invocations through planetary correspondences

edges.label: ascent goal (angelhood) → method (love as motive force)
edges.mechanism: humans' capacity to ascend = love of the seraphim (highest angel)

edges.label: mystical union → cosmological principle
edges.mechanism: binsica (mystical death) = entry into Sefirotic tree; personal experience → universal cosmos

edges.label: cosmology → metaphysics (emanation)
edges.mechanism: hierarchical creation in Genesis → hierarchical participation in being

edges.label: participated being → human dignity
edges.mechanism: humans participate in angelic intellect → capable of free choice and ascent

edges.label: planetary angels → celestial magic invocations
edges.mechanism: Layer 6 astronomical correspondences become practical magic formulas

edges.label: Sefirotic angelology → Kabbalistic theses
edges.mechanism: Layer 5 Kefirotic structure → specific 900 conclusions on Hebrew angelology

edges.label: mystical experience → doctrinal foundation
edges.mechanism: binsica and righteous ascent → Sefirotic path doctrine in 900
